verdict.rationale: Slack documents several official SDKs and frameworks. These include the Node Slack SDK covering more than 200 Web API methods, Bolt for Java, Bolt for Python and JavaScript via the CLI quickstart, and the Deno Slack SDK for TypeScript workflows. A starter-template scaffold (`slack create`) and official OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs back them up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and maintenance.
